name: launchrally
description: Audit and verify production launch readiness from an existing repository.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and verify launch readiness locally.
interface.longDescription: LaunchRally works with Codex and a local deterministic CLI to audit, plan, and verify production launch readiness without autonomous production writes.
defaultPrompt: Audit this JavaScript or non-JavaScript repository for production launch readiness.
Assess this split frontend/backend or multi-app repository without assuming a deployment platform.
Verify this custom framework repository after my remediation changes.
